title: longvarmeth pipeline parameters
description: longvarmeth: long-read variant calling & methylation pipeline

input_output_options.title: Input/Output Options
input_output_options.description: Parameters defining input files and output directory.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved.

workflow_behavior.title: Workflow Behavior Options
workflow_behavior.description: Pipeline execution mode and organism type selection.

run_type.description: Analysis workflow mode: reference-based alignment or de novo assembly.

enable_phasing.description: Enable WhatsHap variant phasing and read haplotagging.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference Genome Options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome paths for alignment and variant calling.

ref_nuc.description: Path to nuclear / primary reference FASTA file.

ref_mt_ap.description: Path to primary mitochondrial reference FASTA file (e.g. Artemia parthenogenetica).

ref_mt_au.description: Path to secondary mitochondrial reference FASTA file (e.g. Artemia urmiana).

dorado_options.title: Dorado Basecalling Options
dorado_options.description: Parameters for GPU-accelerated basecalling and demultiplexing on the host.

dorado_bin.description: Path to local host Dorado executable binary.

gpu_devices.description: CUDA device selection flag for Dorado basecalling (e.g. 'cuda:all', 'cuda:0').

threads.description: Number of CPU threads to allocate for Dorado demux.

filtering_and_assembly_options.title: Read QC, Filtering & Assembly Options
filtering_and_assembly_options.description: Parameters for read filtering, de novo assembly, and QC.

min_barcode_size_mb.description: Minimum barcode size in megabases to proceed with downstream steps.

filt_keep_pct.description: Filtlong percentage of best bases to retain.

medaka_model.description: Medaka model used for assembly polishing consensus.

busco_lineage.description: BUSCO lineage dataset for assembly completeness evaluation.

methylartist_locus.description: Genomic locus coordinates to plot locus-specific methylation with Methylartist (e.g., 'chr1:1000-5000').

snpeff_cache.description: Path to local snpEff cache directory.

enable_vep.description: Enable Ensembl VEP variant effect annotation.

vep_cache.description: Path to local VEP cache directory.
